html:
This half day boat trip is an ideal choice for travelers seeking a relaxing marine experience in Phu Quoc. The tour combines fishing, snorkeling, and island leisure, taking you to two of the most beautiful islands in the south of Phu Quoc. Guests can enjoy crystal clear waters, colorful coral reefs, freshly prepared lunch on board, and peaceful time on May Rut Trong Island, known for its white sand beaches and coconut-lined lagoons.

Duration: 09:30 – 16:30

Highlights

  • Boat trip to two stunning islands in southern Phu Quoc

  • Snorkeling at Xuong (Gam Ghi) Island with vibrant coral reefs

  • Experience local fishing with traditional equipment

  • Lunch served on board

  • Relax, swim, and sunbathe at May Rut Trong Island

Itinerary

09:15 – 09:30

Pick-up at hotels in Duong Dong Ward (for hotels outside this area, please contact us in advance).

Transfer to An Thoi Harbor.

Board the boat and begin the journey to the southern islands of Phu Quoc.

Fishing Experience

Stop at a fishing point for approximately 30 minutes. The tour guide will demonstrate how to use traditional local fishing equipment.

Xuong Island (Gam Ghi Island)

Snorkeling and swimming in clear waters. Admire unspoiled coral reefs with a wide variety of marine life.

Lunch on Board
Enjoy a freshly prepared lunch while relaxing on the boat.

May Rut Trong Island

Free time to rest, swim, sunbathe, stroll along the beach, walk on wooden bridges, relax under coconut trees, or enjoy drinks at the beach bar. Sunbeds and additional services are available at your own expense.

16:30

Return to An Thoi Harbor and transfer back to your hotel.

Tour Price

  • Adult: USD 17 / pax (from 10 years old)

  • Children (5–9 years): USD 10 / pax

  • Children under 5 years: Free of charge

Tour Includes

  • Round-trip transportation by car and boat

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Lunch

  • 1 bottle of water per person

  • Snorkeling equipment (mask, snorkel; fins subject to size availability)

  • Local fishing equipment

  • Life jackets

Tour Excludes

  • Personal expenses

  • Fresh water shower, sunbed rental, and other service fees on the island

Lunch Menu

  • Steamed shrimp

  • Braised fish in clay pot

  • Vegetable soup with minced pork

  • Deep-fried tofu with lemongrass

  • Stir-fried morning glory with garlic

  • Omelette

  • Steamed rice

  • Fresh fruit

Special meal requests (vegetarian, vegan, children’s meals) are available upon request at least 24 hours before departure.

Important Notes

  • In case of unfavorable weather conditions, the captain may change the islands visited based on actual conditions.

  • Please bring towels, swimwear, spare clothes, suitable footwear, and some cash.

Children’s Pricing Policy

  • Children aged 10 and above: adult price

  • Children aged 5–9: 50% of adult price

  • Children under 5: free of charge

Payment Policy

Groups of 1–5 guests:

  • 50% deposit upon booking

  • Balance to be paid no later than 1 day before or on the tour day

Groups of 6 guests or more:

  • 50% deposit upon booking

  • Balance to be paid no later than 1 day before the tour date

Cancellation Policy

Groups of 1–5 guests:

  • Cancellation 1 day before tour: free of charge

  • Cancellation on tour day: 100% charge

Groups of 6 guests or more:

  • Cancellation 2 days before tour: free of charge

  • Cancellation 1 day before tour: 50% charge

  • Cancellation on tour day: 100% charge

Weather-related cancellations:

  • If the Port Authority does not allow departure, Vietlook Travel will cancel and fully refund.

  • If the tour is permitted to operate and guests choose to cancel, no refund will be provided.

Health And Safety

  • Not recommended for guests with limited mobility, serious medical conditions, or wheelchair users.

  • Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult their doctors before joining.

  • Vietlook Travel is not responsible for health-related issues arising during the tour.
